excludeRects.name: line 1 glyph region (Tinos, same font bytes; AA only). PROVISIONAL (issue #60): rects estimated from the layout (frame origin 20 pt, lines about 39 pt apart at 2.5x); fit from the first CI pair. Gated per line by pair_text_report.py: exact outside, half-coverage ink bbox within 1 px, so the tracked line (wider) and the kerned line (narrower) each gate their width
